name: Sea Peoples
startIntroPart1: We are the Sea People. we are a group of nine tribes in the Eastern Mediterranean regions originating around 1200 BC during the Late Bronze Age. We are primarily coastal raiders.
declaringWar: We come from the midst of the sea and none are able to withstand us.
attacked: Your attack on us will be your death
neutralHello: We sail the mighty seas looking for new cultures.
hateHello: The seas are ours! Stay out of the waters.
uniques: Enables [Water] units to enter ocean tiles

name: Minoan civilization
declaringWar: By our strength, we will verthrow thy seed
attacked: You have shed our blood. Now we will shed yours!
defeated: Your power is superior to ours
uniques: [+20]% Production when constructing [Culture] buildings [in all cities]

name: Lycia
startIntroPart1: On behalf of our leader, Kuberniskos Sika, welcome. We have resided here in Anatolia since. 15–14th centuries BC. We were once known as Lukka) and have settled near the Mediterranean Sea
declaringWar: No land can stand before our arms
attacked: An eye dor an eye. Now you die!
defeated: We lay our swords at your feet.
neutralHello: We greet you in the name of peace.
hateHello: We are much more cultured than you.
uniques: May choose [1] additional [Follower] beliefs when [founding] a religion

name: Akkadia
startIntroPart1: The Akkadians greet you. We are a kingdom established around 2300 BCE. Many recognize us as the first empire in world history. We have had many long-lived city-states spread throughout Mesopotamia.
declaringWar: We will tear out thy foundations and destroy thy progeny
attacked: You dare besiege us! We will go forth to battle and defeat you!
defeated: We bow to thee who has destroyed our vast army.
neutralHello: Our greatness will not compare with you but welcome.
uniques: Gain control over [8] tiles [in this city] <upon founding a city>

name: Philistia
startIntroPart1: Greetings from King Iamani of Ashdod. We Philistines originated from Greek migrant groups of the Aegean civilization. From roughly 1200 BC onwards, we settled in the area and gradually intermixed with the indigenous Canaanite population. Our confederation stretched along the Canaanite coast from Arish in the Sinai Peninsula to the Yarkon River running through Tel Aviv, and as far inland as Ekron and Gath.
startIntroPart2: Can you spread our presence far outside of our pentapolis?
declaringWar: We will bring you to your knees!
attacked: You have awakened the Goliath and now you will die!
defeated: We have been bested in a fair fight.
tradeRequest: We welcome trade that can enhance our empire.
uniques: Gain control over [8] tiles [in this city] <upon founding a city>
